resolved_findings.title: Serialize publishers that advance main and latest
resolved_findings.description: The new alias is copied and verified after main, but neither the caller nor publisher recipe serializes concurrent publications. The verifier admits valid older ancestors of protected main. For two successful main builds A and B, A can verify main=A, B can publish and verify main=B/latest=B, then A can publish and verify latest=A. Both calls return success while final main=B/latest=A. This violates the stated same-image alias contract during ordinary overlapping main workflow runs.
resolved_findings.reproduction: Executed the unchanged frozen.publish with two valid archive plans and one independent digest-map registry. Its main-A digest read captured A and interleaved the complete B publication before returning; A then completed latest. Both calls returned published results; final main digest was sha256:bbbb... and latest was sha256:aaaa....
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Serialize the main alias-mutating publisher job across runs without canceling an active publication, or provide equivalent serialization. Preserve admission, producer verification, permissions and credentials. Include the explicit serialization allowance in the recipe normalization contract and scoped activation plan.
resolved_findings.resolution: Publisher recipe job concurrency group ipmi-monitor-main-image-publication with cancel-in-progress:false serializes alias writers. After pinned helper/tool verification and before invoking publication, a literal protected-main API guard rejects a GITHUB_SHA that is no longer current. Existing contents:read job token only; no new inputs, admission, permissions or credentials. Exact recipe-normalization contract preserves baseline beyond explicitly reviewed concurrency, guard and immutable-helper activation changes.
